Overview

Haugesund is a city in Rogaland with a population of 37,000. A coastal town on the west coast, known for its herring history, film festival, and nearby Viking monuments. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
